verdict.rationale: stagewise automatically generates a WORKSPACE.md in .stagewise/ when a workspace is connected, and the docs call this the primary way the agent understands the project at a high level. The agent can also read files across workspaces and run shell commands on its own, so it can explore a codebase without the developer hand-picking context files. missing for 10: explicit documentation of on-demand codebase mapping or explanation (e.g., architecture summaries), detail on how WORKSPACE.md is built and how deep it goes, and any independent or hands-on corroboration of codebase-understanding quality.
